content.text: The text combines several works. In *The Ragged-Trousered Philanthropists*, Philpot dies in a workplace accident; corrupt employers exploit the funeral, while unemployment, poverty, political factionalism, and religious hypocrisy dominate Mugsborough. Ruth leaves Easton after abuse and despair but later reconciles with him; Owen defends child worker Bert and receives Barrington’s aid. Barrington distributes Christmas gifts and plans socialist work. In the appended novel, Eleanor flees New York after romantic complications among her guardians, becomes a nurse at Harmonville Hospital, and eventually returns to Peter, whom she loves. Their reunion follows the dissolution of several misguided engagements. Other excerpts include Regulus choosing patriotic martyrdom, a comic account of Colonel Freddy’s boy soldiers returning home, and notes on Ovid’s Roman circus poetry.
